description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0 (latest LTS)

tasks.description: Upgrade WebApp-Storage-DotNet from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0, including conversion from ASP.NET MVC 5 (System.Web) to ASP.NET Core MVC.
tasks.reason: The project targets the legacy, non-SDK-style .NET Framework (v4.8), which is no longer in active feature development and lacks modern cross-platform runtime, performance, and tooling improvements. The user explicitly requested upgrading to the latest LTS version to ensure long-term support and continued compatibility with the Azure SDK packages already used by the project.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade WebApp-Storage-DotNet from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0 (latest LTS), including SDK-style project conversion, target framework update, migration from ASP.NET MVC 5 (System.Web, Global.asax, Web.config) to ASP.NET Core MVC, migration of NuGet dependencies from packages.config to PackageReference, replacement of incompatible packages, and resolution of any resulting API compatibility issues while preserving existing Azure Blob Storage functionality.
tasks.taskSummary: Migrated the sample to ASP.NET Core MVC on .NET 10. Build passed with no warnings or errors; dotnet test exited successfully (no test projects are defined).
